claude-code.label: Ask for approval
claude-code.description: Claude Code asks through KLIDE before actions that need permission.

claude-code.label: Accept edits
claude-code.description: Apply file edits automatically; other actions still need permission.

claude-code.label: Auto review
claude-code.description: Claude Code’s safety classifier reviews actions for you. Requires a CLI and account that support auto mode.

claude-code.label: Plan
claude-code.description: Use Claude Code’s native planning permissions.

claude-code.label: Pre-approved only
claude-code.description: Deny actions that would require a new approval.

claude-code.label: Bypass permissions
claude-code.description: Skip Claude Code’s normal permission checks for this conversation.

codex.label: Read only
codex.description: Run Codex with its read-only sandbox.

codex.label: Workspace access
codex.description: Allow edits and commands inside Codex’s workspace sandbox. Actions that need an interactive answer may be denied in KLIDE.

codex.label: Approve for me
codex.description: Use Codex’s automatic reviewer while keeping the workspace sandbox. Requires a CLI that supports automatic review.

codex.label: Full access
codex.description: Skip Codex approvals and sandbox restrictions for this conversation.

opencode.label: Auto approve
opencode.description: Approve OpenCode’s pending tool requests. Its configured deny rules still apply.

omp.label: Ask for approval
omp.description: Ask before writes and execution. Actions that need an interactive answer may be denied in KLIDE.

omp.label: Ask and remember
omp.description: Use Oh My Pi’s cached file and folder grants; ungranted actions still ask.

omp.label: Accept writes
omp.description: Allow reads and writes; execution still needs permission.

omp.label: Auto approve
omp.description: Approve tool calls using Oh My Pi’s native yolo mode.

cursor.label: Configured permissions
cursor.description: Follow Cursor’s own permission rules. Actions without approval may be denied in KLIDE.

cursor.label: Force
cursor.description: Allow Cursor to run tools without confirmation using its native force option.

factory.label: Read only
factory.description: Use Droid Exec’s default read-only permissions.

factory.label: Low autonomy
factory.description: Allow file edits and low-risk actions.

factory.label: Medium autonomy
factory.description: Also allow development commands, installs, commits, pushes and pull requests.

factory.label: High autonomy
factory.description: Also allow broader automation, deployments and orchestration.

factory.label: Skip permissions
factory.description: Skip Droid’s permission prompts. Effective command blocks still apply.

copilot.label: Pre-approved tools
copilot.description: Allow edits and project-approved commands; other tools keep Copilot’s permission checks.

copilot.label: Assisted approval
copilot.description: Let Copilot’s native safety judge review permission requests. Requires a supported CLI and policy.

copilot.label: Allow all tools
copilot.description: Approve tools automatically while retaining path and URL checks.

copilot.label: Allow all
copilot.description: Allow all tools, paths and URLs for this conversation.

hermes.label: Configured permissions
hermes.description: Use Hermes’s configured approval mode and KLIDE’s permission relay.

hermes.label: YOLO
hermes.description: Skip Hermes’s normal command approvals for this turn.

vibe.label: Ask for approval
vibe.description: Use Vibe’s ask agent. Actions that need an interactive answer may be denied in KLIDE.

vibe.label: Smart approve
vibe.description: Use Vibe’s native classifier to approve safe actions.

vibe.label: Auto approve
vibe.description: Use Vibe’s native agent that approves tool calls automatically.
